pages.text:
The Skeleton is a common monster that spawns in dark places in the Overworld, including the surface at night. It attacks players on sight by keeping its distance and firing with a Bow. It burns when exposed to sunlight.

A Skeleton may spawn wearing armor, making it tougher and protecting it from sunlight if it wears a helmet.
Skeletons drop Bones on death. They can be used to tame Wolves or to make Bone Meal to fertilize plants.
